<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This is a standard AUR `.install` hook file for the key2touch package. It defines `post_install()` and `post_upgrade()` functions.

`post_install()` loads the `uinput` kernel module with `modprobe uinput`, triggers udev rules for the uinput device, and prints instructions telling the user to add themselves to the `input` group so the application can access input devices. `post_upgrade()` simply re-triggers udev for uinput.

All operations are routine system configuration directly supporting the application's stated purpose (reading keyboards and creating a virtual touchscreen). There is no network activity, no obfuscation or encoded payloads, no data exfiltration, and no execution of untrusted remote code. The visible entity-like sequences are ordinary encodings of shell metacharacters, not hidden commands.

This matches standard AUR packaging practice for device permissions and kernel module loading, and shows no signs of supply-chain injection.
</details>
